svg.text: Figure 4.7: Google Cloud Firestore Physical Database Schema & Storage Architecture

g.text: INDEX: (country_code ASC, account_status ASC, created_at DESC)
Collection: "service_listings" • Fields: (industry_id ASC, is_active ASC, created_at DESC)
Guarantees O(log N) tree traversal for cold-start KD-Tree memory hydration without full scans.
INDEX: (listing_ref ASC, executed_at DESC) • Sub-50ms audit telemetry lookup
PK country_code: String ("KE", "US") • ppp_conversion_factor: Float • cost_of_living_index: Float
last_recalibrated_at: Timestamp • In-memory read-through cache (1-hour TTL)
PK industry_id: String ("fintech", "ai_ml") • industry_name: String • baseline_clearing_rate: Number
parent_sector: String • is_active: Boolean • kdtree_leaf_size: 40 • min_sample_threshold: 5
PK bracket_id: String ("b1".."b15") • min_amount: Number • max_amount: Number • transfer_fee: Number
Statutory regulatory tariff dynamically appended exclusively to domestic Kenyan settlements.

svg.text: Physical Storage Architecture & Index Governance Invariants (Google Cloud Firestore):
Zero database bloat; eliminates binary file storage.
• Query Complexity: O(log N) depth B-Tree traversal
• Query Execution SLA: < 50 ms index retrieval
• Macro indices cached in-memory during container boot
Guarantees zero multi-table relational join latency.
